summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built Large Language Models and generative AI systems end to end in Python and PyTorch, including a GPT-2 style Transformer and tokenizer written from scratch and an 8-bit quantized LLM benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC. Integrated LLM APIs into a live multi-service application over a Flask-SocketIO backend, evaluating model quality and latency trade-offs.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free vision-language Transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16 and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU to report accuracy-latency trade-offs.
Led a cross-functional team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the full pipeline in 6 weeks.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI in PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time laboratory data acquisition and visualization; used GitLab and JupyterHub for version control and collaborative analysis.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch from scratch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and a custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity-based evaluation of generated text.

projects.name: LLM Compression and Benchmarking
bullets: Benchmarked TinyLlama 1.1B on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC after 8-bit quantization, holding accuracy degradation under 1% at +0.09 perplexity.
Cut GPU memory footprint by ~55% with bitsandbytes LLM.int8(); profiled peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml to quantify the quality-versus-efficiency trade-off.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Assistant Pipeline (COFFIN), M.S. Capstone
bullets: Integrated the Gemini API for natural-language intent classification under 500 ms, routing free-form user speech to the correct downstream tool call in a live three-layer application.
Built the backend as a Flask-SocketIO server bridging a Flutter client and an edge controller over a unified WebSocket API; resolved 11 integration failures to reach 100% task reliability.
